name: PerceptionState
src_typeComment: Unaware -> Suspicious -> Alert -> (fades back down over time). Upgrades VisionCone from a binary seen/not-seen check into a real stealth-detection state with memory: an AI can investigate where it LAST saw something instead of either being omniscient or instantly forgetting. Composed on top of VisionCone (not a modification of it) — drop this alongside an existing VisionCone to add memory without touching the sensing logic itself.  Tracks ONE primary target at a time (the most recently spotted one) rather than a per-target memory list — the common case (a guard reacting to the player) only ever needs one, and this keeps the state machine simple. For multiple simultaneously-tracked targets, use one PerceptionMemory per target of interest instead.
